cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(needle_fusion LANGUAGES C CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(LLAMA_SOURCE_DIR "" CACHE PATH "Checkout of the pinned llama.cpp revision")
set(LLAMA_PIN "42b021b4dc42be573f1e1463528532fc8294c650")
if(NOT EXISTS "${LLAMA_SOURCE_DIR}/CMakeLists.txt")
  message(FATAL_ERROR "Set LLAMA_SOURCE_DIR to a checkout of ${LLAMA_PIN}")
endif()
execute_process(COMMAND git rev-parse HEAD WORKING_DIRECTORY "${LLAMA_SOURCE_DIR}"
  OUTPUT_VARIABLE LLAMA_REV OUTPUT_STRIP_TRAILING_WHITESPACE COMMAND_ERROR_IS_FATAL ANY)
if(NOT LLAMA_REV STREQUAL LLAMA_PIN)
  message(FATAL_ERROR "llama.cpp revision ${LLAMA_REV} does not match ${LLAMA_PIN}")
endif()
execute_process(COMMAND git diff --quiet HEAD -- WORKING_DIRECTORY "${LLAMA_SOURCE_DIR}"
  RESULT_VARIABLE LLAMA_DIRTY)
if(NOT LLAMA_DIRTY EQUAL 0)
  message(FATAL_ERROR "Pinned llama.cpp source has local changes")
endif()
set(LLAMA_BUILD_TESTS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(LLAMA_BUILD_EXAMPLES OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(LLAMA_BUILD_TOOLS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(LLAMA_BUILD_SERVER OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(GGML_BACKEND_DL OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
add_subdirectory("${LLAMA_SOURCE_DIR}" llama)
add_library(needle_fusion_encoder STATIC encoder.cpp)
set_target_properties(needle_fusion_encoder PROPERTIES POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE YES)
target_compile_definitions(needle_fusion_encoder PUBLIC EG_STATIC)
target_link_libraries(needle_fusion_encoder PRIVATE llama ggml ggml-base ggml-cpu)
target_include_directories(needle_fusion_encoder PUBLIC "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}")
set_property(DIRECTORY APPEND PROPERTY CMAKE_CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/encoder.cpp")
file(SHA256 "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/encoder.cpp" EG_SOURCE_SHA256)
target_compile_definitions(needle_fusion_encoder PRIVATE EG_BUILD LLAMA_PIN="${LLAMA_PIN}" EG_SOURCE_SHA256="${EG_SOURCE_SHA256}")
install(TARGETS needle_fusion_encoder LIBRARY DESTINATION lib RUNTIME DESTINATION bin)
install(FILES encoder.h DESTINATION include)
